Hello Touchstone team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for interior designers in Chennai. I was looking at tispl.in this week. On a phone, your first screen is dark and the headline runs off the right edge, so it reads “Design & Build Soluti…”. Most people look you up on their phone first, so that first screen matters.

So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:
A:
See it live: https://jananiporkodi.github.io/revamp/techno-interior-solutions/
Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. You walk through workspaces you've built, from an open work floor and breakout corner to the Aspire Systems cafeteria, the Pinnacle lounge and TCS Navalur.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “an office interior designer in Ambattur”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now tispl.in has a few of the basics, but not the full set these tools look for. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.

What you get for ₹25,000 (one-time)

  • This new website, live on your own domain (tispl.in)
  • Works smoothly on phones and computers
  • Ready for AI search: your services, project types, address and answers to common questions, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers can read and recommend you
  • A “book a site visit” button that sends the date straight to your WhatsApp
  • Call and WhatsApp buttons on every screen
  • Basic Google setup, so businesses searching for office interior designers in Ambattur can find you
  • Two rounds of changes: new photos, prices, wording, anything you like
  • One month of free fixes after launch
  • Free hosting: no monthly server bill
  • Payment: half to start, half when the site goes live

Timeline: live in 7 days

  • Day 1: a quick call, and we start
  • Days 2–3: you send any new photos or changes
  • Day 5: you see the updated version
  • Day 7: it goes live on tispl.in

If you like it, just reply to this email or WhatsApp me on +91 98844 26074, and I'll call you at a time that suits you. If it's not for you, no problem. I'll take the preview down.

Warm regards,
